description.value: ChongQing Restaurant is a multi-location Szechuanese Chinese restaurant that has operated in the Vancouver area for over twenty years. The Kingsway location in Burnaby offers both dine-in with indoor seating and online ordering for takeout and delivery. It is one of four Lower Mainland locations, making it a recognizable chain stop for cyclists traveling along the Kingsway corridor.
